codeReview.summary: Solid implementation of three temperature physics features for SpaSim: configurable ambient temperature, pump waste heat contribution, and enhanced heater/pump interlock with auto-resume. All features default to backward-compatible values. TDD was followed (tests written first, then implementation). 11 well-structured tests covering all expected behaviors with good edge case coverage including circ_pump satisfying interlock and multi-pump additive heat. Architecture.md was updated to reflect the new capabilities.

issues.description: Pump heat upper_bound logic uses `overshoot_target.max(current_temp + heat_gain)`, which means when current_temp already exceeds overshoot_target, the upper bound becomes current_temp + heat_gain — effectively no cap. Pump heat can accumulate unboundedly above set_temp + overshoot if no cooling counteracts it. In practice this is mitigated by the cooling branch (line 1117) which fires when current_temp > max(ambient, set_temp), but the upper_bound comment is slightly misleading. Consider capping at overshoot_target or removing the .min() entirely since the cooling branch handles regulation.

set_ambient_temp() does not validate or clamp input (e.g., negative values), unlike set_pump_heat_contribution() which clamps to >= 0.0. A negative ambient temperature would produce negative cooling deltas. Minor inconsistency in API design, but acceptable for a simulator where callers are expected to provide reasonable values.

summary: PASS — Clean implementation of configurable ambient temp, pump waste heat, and heater/pump interlock with auto-resume. All 11 new tests pass, no regressions. Worker followed TDD procedure faithfully. Two minor non-blocking observations: (1) pump heat upper bound is effectively uncapped when current_temp > overshoot_target, though cooling counteracts in practice, (2) set_ambient_temp lacks input validation unlike set_pump_heat_contribution. Both are cosmetic/edge-case concerns that don't affect correctness for typical use.
